The absence of opcode display functionality in the `monitor_disas` and `target_disas` functions is primarily due to the `s.info.print_insn` being set to `NULL`, which means no instruction printing function is defined, and `s.info.show_opcodes` not being explicitly set to `true`, preventing the display of opcodes during disassembly.

s.info.show_opcodes = true;
```
